say: An Opus planner splits the app into parts, and Haiku agents take them, each on its own copy of the code.
The dark mode lands on top of the rest while the other agents work, and collisions are redone on the newest code. All nine parts landed in twenty-two minutes, for under two dollars of model time.
The timeline shows where the time went, agent by agent.
And the app is live, with its dark mode.
